ruleDefinitions.name: Hidden Powershell in Link File Pattern
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects events that appear when a user click on a link file with a powershell command in it

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd\.exe" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.lnk.*")))
